## About Trash Qwins (TrashQwins)
Trash Qwins (also written TrashQwins) is a Kenyan waste-to-value enterprise transforming discarded glass bottles and organic waste into commercial resources and sustainable livelihoods through recovery, aggregation, recycling, upcycling, and Black Soldier Fly (BSF) bioconversion technology.

## Core Business Pillars
- **Qwins Glass** (https://www.trashqwins.com/glass-recovery): Systematic hospitality and urban glass bottle collection, sorting, aggregation, bulk cullet supply for recyclers, and artisan upcycled glassware (cut tumblers, botanical vases, candleholders, and hand-painted wine bottles).
- **Qwins Organics** (https://www.trashqwins.com/bsf-organics): Organic food scrap and market waste diversion using Black Soldier Fly (BSF) technology to produce high-protein insect meal for poultry, fish, and pig farming, plus mineral-rich organic frass bio-fertilizer for soil fertility.
- **Qwins Solutions** (https://www.trashqwins.com/solutions): Decentralized waste aggregation hubs, Material Recovery Facility (MRF) coordination, waste picker alliances, circular economy consultancy, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) advisory, and community capacity building.

## Markets & Partners
Hotels, restaurants, bars, Material Recovery Facilities (MRFs), community-based organizations (CBOs), waste picker groups, glass recyclers, livestock farmers, agribusinesses, and county governments in Kenya.
